prompt:
Handheld close-up, the camera nearly motionless. Bob holds the hard stare for a moment, then his jaw unlocks, his shoulders drop and he lets out a long breath that steams in the cold air. The narrowed eyes open a little; his brow lifts; he looks Tarquin up and down, then back to his face, slowly, as if seeing him properly. A small shake of the head, lips closed. Rain keeps falling; firelight moves across his face. Sound: rain, the fire crackling, one long exhale. No speech.
Thanks.
